name: codebuddy-lark-plugin
description: CodeBuddy Code channel plugin: bridge Lark/Feishu bot messages to a CodeBuddy session.

scripts.build: node build.mjs && node scripts/patch-dist.mjs && chmod +x dist/index.cjs
scripts.postinstall: node scripts/patch-dist.mjs || echo '(patch-dist skipped; only runs in repo, not in installed cache)'
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json || echo '(tsc segfault on lark sdk types in some envs; runtime uses esbuild/tsx)'
